title: Biased linear score
statement: For $p\in\mathbb R$ and a sign vector $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$, the biased linear score is the sum over all coordinates $i<n$ of the biased standardized sign of $x_i$ at bias $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
caveat: The definition of the biased standardized sign is not included in the supplied definitions.
